objective: Select or reject a sharper internally routed recurrent-value bottleneck after raw temperature-1 cosine routing failed the native causal benchmark.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: The internally routed read was material but correct state lost to zero and matched-donor state on the authorized native development benchmark.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Sharpen the internal RWKV cosine distribution or select its top slot; do not reintroduce projected addressing.

architecture.router_equation: softmax(temperature * cosine(S_slot r_t, r_t)) over nonempty RWKV slots, optionally restricted to top-k

causal_conditions.correct: Correct-row recurrent and projected online state.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while all recurrent tensors are zero.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while recurrent tensors come from the locked different-gold, write-length-matched donor.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while complete recurrent bundles rotate by one wrapped layer.
causal_conditions.zero_projected_bundle: Correct recurrent state with all projected keys, values, occupancy, and surprise tensors zero.
causal_conditions.empty_memory: All projected and recurrent online-state tensors zeroed.

execution.distribution: one already-open source/donor pair per rank; no optimizer update
execution.evaluation: teacher-forced answer logits on the native read sequence

selection_rule: Select the first passing candidate in the preregistered grid: the lowest soft temperature first, then the hard top-1 fallback.

stopping_rule.pass: A selected candidate authorizes only a separately locked one-update causal-gradient calibration on the same already-open rows.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the failure and add a learned null/abstention route before training.
stopping_rule.always: Archive, commit, and push the result.

claim_policy.screen_pass: May claim only that sharper internal routing is BF16-visible, nonuniform on every layer, bounded, and independent of the complete projected bundle.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later training and evaluation on an authorized open native development partition.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
